mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP growth rate signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high GDP growth, or GDP growth is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during easing periods than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment, or unemployment rate is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high housing starts and low unemployment, or the interaction between housing starts and unemployment rate is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during periods of high industrial production, or industrial production is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low federal funds rate and high money supply, or the interaction between federal funds rate and money supply is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of high payroll employment, or payroll employment is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index signals a decrease in inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during periods of low consumer price index, or consumer price index is not significantly correlated with S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).
